name: frac_unsheltered
definition: Share of the modelled service population that is unsheltered at baseline

name: frac_sheltered
definition: Share of the modelled service population that is sheltered at baseline
transformation: remainder is already housed but still service-attached

name: age_mean
definition: Mean age at entry to the modelled service population

name: age_sd
definition: Standard deviation of age at entry

name: age_min
definition: Youngest modelled adult

name: age_max
definition: Oldest modelled adult at entry

name: inflow_rate_per_year
definition: New entries into the service population per baseline person-year
transformation: exogenous inflow, identical in every arm

name: migration_rate_per_year
definition: Rate of leaving the modelled catchment alive (distinct from death and from exiting homelessness)

name: exposure_share_g0
definition: Share of the population in exposure group 0 (lowest sexual exposure)
transformation: group shares are renormalised to sum to 1

name: exposure_share_g1
definition: Share of the population in exposure group 1

name: exposure_share_g2
definition: Share of the population in exposure group 2

name: exposure_share_g3
definition: Share of the population in exposure group 3 (highest sexual exposure)

name: exposure_rate_sex_g0
definition: Relative sexual exposure rate, group 0
transformation: relative units; absolute scale is lambda_sex_scale

name: exposure_rate_sex_g1
definition: Relative sexual exposure rate, group 1

name: exposure_rate_sex_g2
definition: Relative sexual exposure rate, group 2

name: exposure_rate_sex_g3
definition: Relative sexual exposure rate, group 3

name: frac_injects_g0
definition: Share of group 0 that shares injection equipment

name: frac_injects_g1
definition: Share of group 1 that shares injection equipment

name: frac_injects_g2
definition: Share of group 2 that shares injection equipment

name: frac_injects_g3
definition: Share of group 3 that shares injection equipment

name: lambda_sex_scale
definition: Scale converting group mixing and infectious prevalence into an annual sexual acquisition hazard

name: lambda_inj_scale
definition: Scale converting sharing mixing and infectious prevalence into an annual injection-route hazard

name: mixing_assortativity
definition: Weight on within-group mixing; remainder mixes proportionally

name: external_hazard_sex_annual
definition: Annual sexual acquisition hazard from partners outside the modelled population

name: external_hazard_inj_annual
definition: Annual injection-route acquisition hazard from outside the modelled population

name: infectiousness_acute
definition: Relative sexual infectiousness during acute infection

name: infectiousness_advanced
definition: Relative sexual infectiousness during advanced untreated disease

name: infectiousness_suppressed_sexual
definition: Relative sexual infectiousness when durably virally suppressed
population: people with HIV on suppressive ART

name: infectiousness_suppressed_injection
definition: Relative injection-route infectiousness when virally suppressed
population: people with HIV on suppressive ART
transformation: the sexual zero-risk claim is deliberately not extended here

name: acute_duration_years
definition: Mean duration of acute infection before chronic stage

name: chronic_to_advanced_rate
definition: Annual rate of progression from untreated chronic infection to advanced disease
population: people with HIV not on ART
transformation: mean time to advanced disease about 8.7 years

name: advanced_mortality_rate
definition: Annual HIV mortality rate in untreated advanced disease

name: chronic_mortality_excess
definition: Annual excess mortality in untreated chronic infection

name: art_mortality_multiplier
definition: Multiplier on HIV-attributable mortality while virally suppressed on ART
population: people with HIV on suppressive ART

name: art_regression_rate
definition: Annual rate of returning from advanced disease to chronic disease on effective ART
population: people with advanced HIV on ART
transformation: immune reconstitution; HIV infection itself never reverts

name: suppression_rate_on_art
definition: Annual rate of achieving viral suppression after ART initiation
population: people with HIV newly on ART
transformation: mean time to suppression about 6-7 weeks

name: art_failure_rate
definition: Annual rate of losing viral suppression while nominally on ART

name: testing_rate_annual
definition: Background HIV testing rate outside the modelled programme

name: testing_rate_advanced_multiplier
definition: Multiplier on testing rate once advanced disease produces symptoms

name: art_init_rate_annual
definition: Annual rate of ART initiation after diagnosis

name: disengage_rate_annual
definition: Annual rate of disengaging from HIV care while on ART

name: reengage_rate_annual
definition: Annual rate of returning to HIV care after disengagement
population: diagnosed people with HIV out of care

name: bg_mortality_18_29
definition: Background (non-HIV) annual mortality, ages 18-29, housed reference

name: bg_mortality_30_44
definition: Background (non-HIV) annual mortality, ages 30-44, housed reference

name: bg_mortality_45_59
definition: Background (non-HIV) annual mortality, ages 45-59, housed reference

name: bg_mortality_60_plus
definition: Background (non-HIV) annual mortality, ages 60 and over, housed reference

name: mortality_multiplier_unsheltered
definition: Multiplier on background mortality while unsheltered

name: mortality_multiplier_sheltered
definition: Multiplier on background mortality while sheltered

name: housing_rate_u_to_s
definition: Annual rate of moving from unsheltered to sheltered

name: housing_rate_u_to_h
definition: Annual rate of moving from unsheltered to housed

name: housing_rate_s_to_u
definition: Annual rate of moving from sheltered to unsheltered

name: housing_rate_s_to_h
definition: Annual rate of moving from sheltered to housed

name: housing_rate_h_to_s
definition: Annual rate of returning from housed to sheltered

name: housing_rate_h_to_u
definition: Annual rate of returning from housed to unsheltered

name: baseline_hiv_prevalence
definition: HIV prevalence (diagnosed and undiagnosed) at baseline

name: baseline_undiagnosed_fraction
definition: Share of prevalent infection that is undiagnosed at baseline

name: baseline_art_among_diagnosed
definition: Share of diagnosed people on ART at baseline
population: diagnosed adults experiencing homelessness with HIV

name: baseline_suppressed_among_art
definition: Share of people on ART who are virally suppressed at baseline

name: baseline_oral_prep_use
definition: Share of eligible HIV-negative people using daily oral PrEP at baseline
transformation: existing prevention stays in the baseline

name: len_efficacy_sexual
definition: Protective efficacy of lenacapavir against sexual acquisition while adequately dosed
transformation: trial efficacy; programme participation is modelled separately

name: cab_efficacy_sexual
definition: Protective efficacy of cabotegravir against sexual acquisition while adequately dosed

name: oral_efficacy_sexual
definition: Real-world effective protection of daily oral PrEP against sexual acquisition, adherence included
transformation: efficacy times typical adherence in unstably housed populations

name: injectable_efficacy_injection_route
definition: Protective efficacy of injectable PrEP against equipment-sharing acquisition, primary analysis
transformation: conservative structural assumption, not a finding of zero biological effect

name: oral_efficacy_injection_route
definition: Protective efficacy of daily oral PrEP against equipment-sharing acquisition

name: len_dose_interval_weeks
definition: Lenacapavir maintenance dosing interval

name: len_tail_weeks
definition: Weeks after the due date over which lenacapavir protection declines to zero
transformation: waning scenario, not a validated concentration curve

name: cab_first_interval_weeks
definition: Interval between the first and second cabotegravir injections

name: cab_dose_interval_weeks
definition: Cabotegravir maintenance dosing interval

name: cab_tail_weeks
definition: Weeks after the due date over which cabotegravir protection declines to zero

name: reach_rate_annual_clinic
definition: Annual rate at which an eligible person is reached with a clinic-based offer

name: reach_rate_annual_lowbarrier
definition: Annual rate at which an eligible person is reached with a low-barrier outreach offer

name: reach_multiplier_unsheltered
definition: Multiplier on clinic reach while unsheltered
transformation: low-barrier delivery narrows this gap, see reach_multiplier_unsheltered_lowbarrier

name: reach_multiplier_unsheltered_lowbarrier
definition: Multiplier on low-barrier reach while unsheltered

name: reach_exposure_gradient
definition: Multiplicative change in reach per step up the exposure-group ladder
transformation: values below 1 mean higher-exposure people are harder to reach

name: accept_prob_clinic
definition: Probability of accepting an injectable PrEP offer in a clinic setting

name: accept_prob_lowbarrier
definition: Probability of accepting an injectable PrEP offer in a low-barrier setting

name: initiate_given_accept_clinic
definition: Probability of receiving a first injection after accepting, clinic pathway
transformation: covers screening, authorisation and supply delay

name: initiate_given_accept_lowbarrier
definition: Probability of receiving a first injection after accepting, low-barrier pathway

name: attendance_prob_clinic
definition: Probability of attending a scheduled injection visit, clinic pathway
transformation: per scheduled visit, not per year

name: attendance_prob_lowbarrier
definition: Probability of attending a scheduled injection visit, low-barrier pathway
transformation: 47 of 52 injections on time in a 15-person cohort is implementation evidence, not a long-run retention estimate

name: reengage_prob_weekly_after_lapse
definition: Weekly probability of re-engaging after a missed injection visit, low-barrier pathway
population: PrEP recipients who missed a visit
transformation: clinic pathway uses half this value

name: capacity_initiations_per_1000_per_week
definition: Programme capacity for first injections
transformation: binding capacity constraint, not an unlimited programme

name: capacity_contacts_per_1000_per_week
definition: Programme capacity for outreach contacts

name: cost_len_per_dose
definition: Net acquisition cost of one lenacapavir maintenance dose
transformation: announced launch list price of 28218 USD per person-year divided by two doses; a list price, not a contract price. The range is a policy range running from a hypothetical negotiated price up to the announced list price, not a measured distribution of transaction prices

name: cost_cab_per_dose
definition: Net acquisition cost of one cabotegravir maintenance dose
transformation: list-price order of magnitude, not a verified net price

name: cost_oral_prep_annual
definition: Annual acquisition cost of generic daily oral PrEP

name: cost_contact_clinic
definition: Incremental staff and facility cost of one clinic PrEP contact
transformation: charged whether or not an injection follows

name: cost_contact_lowbarrier
definition: Incremental staff, outreach, transport and navigation cost of one low-barrier contact
transformation: charged whether or not an injection follows

name: cost_hiv_test
definition: Cost of one HIV screening test including confirmation and result delivery

name: cost_program_fixed_annual_per_1000
definition: Fixed programme cost per 1000 eligible people per year
transformation: supervision, vehicles, cold chain, data systems

name: cost_hiv_care_undiagnosed
definition: Annual HIV-attributable medical cost while undiagnosed

name: cost_hiv_care_diagnosed_noart
definition: Annual HIV-attributable medical cost, diagnosed and not on ART
population: people with HIV not on ART

name: cost_hiv_care_art_unsuppressed
definition: Annual HIV-attributable medical cost, on ART and not suppressed

name: cost_hiv_care_art_suppressed
definition: Annual HIV-attributable medical cost, on ART and suppressed

name: cost_hiv_care_advanced
definition: Additional annual medical cost during advanced disease
transformation: added on top of the care-state cost

name: cost_non_hiv_care_annual
definition: Annual non-HIV healthcare cost, all arms
transformation: background cost, cancels in the incremental comparison unless survival differs

name: cost_housing_day_unsheltered
definition: Public cost per unsheltered person-day attributable to the housing system

name: cost_housing_day_sheltered
definition: Public cost per sheltered person-day
transformation: average cost; a fixed shelter budget does not fall when a bed-day is avoided

name: cost_housing_day_housed
definition: Public cost per supported-housing person-day
population: formerly homeless adults in supported housing

name: cost_hiv_attributable_housing_annual
definition: Additional HIV-attributable housing or medical respite cost
transformation: zero in the primary analysis; raise only with a source

name: cost_patient_time_per_visit
definition: Patient time and transport cost per programme visit

name: utility_hiv_negative
definition: Health utility, HIV negative

name: utility_hiv_undiagnosed
definition: Health utility, undiagnosed HIV

name: utility_hiv_diagnosed_noart
definition: Health utility, diagnosed HIV not on ART

name: utility_hiv_art
definition: Health utility, on ART

name: utility_hiv_advanced
definition: Health utility during advanced disease

name: utility_decrement_unsheltered
definition: Utility decrement while unsheltered

name: utility_decrement_sheltered
definition: Utility decrement while sheltered

name: life_expectancy_hiv_negative_at_45
definition: Remaining life expectancy at age 45 without HIV, homelessness-adjusted
transformation: used only for the terminal value beyond the simulated horizon

name: life_expectancy_hiv_suppressed_at_45
definition: Remaining life expectancy at age 45 with suppressed HIV, homelessness-adjusted

name: life_expectancy_hiv_unsuppressed_at_45
definition: Remaining life expectancy at age 45 with unsuppressed HIV, homelessness-adjusted

name: lifetime_hiv_cost_bingham2019
definition: Discounted lifetime HIV-related medical cost of one infection
transformation: analytic prototype cross-check only; never added on top of simulated lifetime care costs

name: hiv_test_sensitivity_acute
definition: Probability that a programme HIV screening test detects acute infection
transformation: the label's concern about initiating during undetected acute infection

name: refusal_permanent_prob
definition: Probability that declining an offer means declining every future offer

name: linkage_prob_program_diagnosis
definition: Probability of prompt ART linkage after a programme-detected diagnosis
population: people newly diagnosed through the programme
transformation: this is the mechanism arm E isolates

name: oral_after_stopping_prob
definition: Probability of moving to daily oral PrEP after discontinuing the injectable

name: ae_discontinuation_rate_annual
definition: Annual rate of discontinuation attributed to adverse events

name: cost_adverse_event_annual
definition: Annual cost of managing injection-related adverse events per participant
